headline: FAO Raises Global Cereal Production Forecast to 2.999 Billion Metric Tons
summary: The FAO raised its global cereal production forecast to 2.999 billion metric tons, with global cereal stocks expected to increase by 17.2 million tons, largely driven by higher wheat inventories in Russia.
why: Global cereal production and inventory forecasts are key benchmarks for agricultural commodity markets and food price inflation.
why_moved: Upward revisions to global cereal production and inventory estimates indicate higher supply availability.
